question: Should omitted Active Memory agent targets replace the shipped explicit opt-in contract with every configured agent?
rationale: The linked bug proves inconsistent gating, but the original merged implementation and released documentation deliberately require listed agent ids, so broad inheritance is a product and upgrade decision.

options.title: Preserve explicit targeting
options.body: Narrow the repair to consistent command and recall gating without activating all configured agents.

options.title: Approve inherited targeting
options.body: Adopt every configured agent as the new omitted-field contract and explicitly own the upgrade-visible behavior.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Decline this direction and retain explicit agent lists plus the documented workaround.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit targeting
recommendation.body: Narrow the repair to consistent command and recall gating without activating all configured agents.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the feature and its explicit targeting semantics in the merged implementation.
